listing.name: Mayasuran Fighter Expansion
listing.summary: Add-on mod for Mayasuran Navy adding 14 pilotable strikecrafts, 2 new fighter wings and 3 corvettes that bridge gap between strikecraft and frigates. Additionally, optional Kadur Remnant submod is included in the zip that adds 2 pilotable variants of Kadur-Mayasuran strikecraft.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 14 pilotable strikecrafts, 2 new fighter wings, and 3 corvettes to the Mayasuran Navy.

description:
>>Download Mayasuran Fighter Expansion<<
Download Mayasuran-Kadur Fighter Expansion submod.

Links broken, add-ons broken, but I am working on restoring them. Need to deal with IRL stuff first though.

Add-on mod for Mayasuran Navy adding 14 pilotable strikecrafts, 2 new fighter wings and 3 corvettes that bridge gap between strikecraft and frigates.
Additionally, optional Kadur Remnant submod is included in the zip that adds 2 pilotable variants of Kadur-Mayasuran strikecraft.
Feedback is very welcome!

Requirements:
Mayasuran Navy
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=13239.0
Arma Armatura
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=18751.0

Special thanks:
King Chase for permission to use Mayasuran assets.
gettag for answering my questions regarding ARMAA and being absolute champ with adding strikecraft_medium and strikecraft_large tags

Changelog:

Spoiler
MFE v1.2
====================================================
-Added Shri Mining Barge
-Added Kali Interceptor Corvette
-Renamed Shri Patrol Corvette to Shri (M) Patrol Corvette
